content.text:
I called the R2 CORS update tool for `demo-uploads` with one rule. It allows GET and HEAD from `https://app.demo.example`, exposes ETag, Content-Length and Content-Type, and caches preflight responses for 24 hours. This was a dry run, so nothing was sent to Cloudflare.

The bucket also needs a public route for browsers to read from, either a custom domain or the r2.dev domain, and I did not set one up. Say if you want me to add one.
